llm_analysis.reasoning: Justin demonstrates exceptional technical depth in core edge AI competencies—TensorRT optimization, CUDA kernel engineering, computer vision, and real-time inference architecture—all validated in the COFFIN capstone. However, significant gaps exist in MLOps infrastructure, cloud training pipelines, and the seniority mismatch (2 years vs. 10+ required for Staff-level) is substantial. He is well-positioned for a mid-level technical role (Senior SWE IC) but may be rejected for Staff or routed downward; applying carries screening risk on seniority, though his IC depth and production systems thinking merit consideration.
